Récupérez le colis, effectuez votre voya: Pick up the package, make your trip and hand it over in person to the recipient. Receive your payment once delivery is confirmed
Une Nouvelle ère de livraison au Maroc: A new era of delivery in Morocco
Envoyer vos colis à prix réduit: Send your packages at a reduced price
Profitez des trajets de notre communauté: Take advantage of our community's trips to ship your items all over Morocco. Whether it's an urgent document or a bulky bag, find a trusted traveler in a few clicks and save up to 50% on your usual delivery costs
Vous voyagez souvent entre les villes du: Do you travel often between the cities of the Kingdom? Don't drive empty anymore! Offer the free space in your trunk to carry packages and offset your fuel and toll costs. It's simple, eco-friendly and friendly
La sécurité est notre priorité. Chaque m: Safety is our priority. Every ColiFlow member goes through a rigorous identity verification process (ID). Check other users' reviews and ratings to choose your transport partner with complete peace of mind. Your package is in good hands
Comment puis-je avoir confiance en un vo: How can I trust a traveler ?
Tous nos voyageurs passent par un proces: All our travelers go through a strict verification process (ID and phone number validation). In addition, our review system lets you choose a reliable profile based on community feedback.
Oui, l'inscription sur ColiFlow est 100%: Yes, registration on ColiFlow is 100% free, whether you are a sender or a traveler. You only pay the service fee when a transaction is confirmed.
Quels types de colis sont interdits ?: What types of packages are prohibited ?
Pour des raisons de sécurité et pour res: For safety reasons and to comply with Moroccan law, it is strictly forbidden to send illegal substances, weapons, flammable products, live animals or any dangerous object.
Absolument. Vos données sont cryptées et: Absolutely. Your data is encrypted and stored securely. We never share your personal information with third parties, and the built-in chat lets you communicate without revealing your phone number.
Les frais sont fixés librement entre l'e: Fees are set freely between the sender and the traveler. When you make a request, you propose a price, and the traveler can accept it or negotiate it via our built-in messaging.
Que faire si mon colis n'est pas arrivé: What should I do if my package has not arrived ?
La sécurité est notre priorité. Votre pa: Safety is our priority. Your payment is held on our platform and is only transferred to the traveler after delivery is confirmed. In case of a dispute, our customer support steps in quickly to assist you.
ColiFlow couvre l'ensemble du territoire: ColiFlow covers the entire Moroccan territory! As long as a traveler makes the trip between your departure city and your destination (e.g. Casablanca - Tangier), you can entrust your package to them.
Le paiement s'effectue de manière 100% s: Payment is made in a 100% secure way on the app at the time of booking. The money is held securely by ColiFlow and is only released to the traveler once the package has been handed over in person.
Puis-je annuler une demande d'envoi ?: Can I cancel a shipping request ?
Oui, vous pouvez annuler gratuitement vo: Yes, you can cancel your request for free as long as it has not been accepted by a traveler. If the trip is already confirmed, cancellation conditions may apply.
Comment puis-je suivre mon colis ?: How can I track my package ?
Vous pouvez suivre l'évolution de votre: You can track the progress of your shipment (Pending, Picked up, On the way, Delivered) directly from your dashboard. The chat also lets you stay in touch with the traveler in real time.
D'autres questions ? Discutez avec nous: More questions ? Chat with us on

items.q: What happens if my package is lost ?
items.a: We encourage all users to purchase our “Parcel Security” insurance options for high-value items. In the event of loss, our support team will help you resolve the issue.

items.q: How can I have my account verified ?
items.a: Go to your profile settings and upload a clear photo of your ID. Verification usually takes less than 24 hours. Verified users receive a badge on their profile.

items.title: Identification
items.desc: Users must provide a valid ID (CIN) in order to be verified on the platform. This ensures the safety and accountability of all community members.

items.title: Payments and Escrow
items.desc: Payments are held in escrow through our e-wallet system until the recipient confirms delivery. Funds are released only once the delivery is marked as complete.

items.title: Prohibited items
items.desc: Illegal substances, hazardous materials, and any items that violate Moroccan or international law are strictly prohibited. Any violation will result in the immediate suspension of the account.

items.title: Platform Liability
items.desc: ColiFlow serves as a platform to connect users and is not responsible for the contents of packages. Users are solely responsible for the items they send or transport.

citiesCovered.title: Cities Covered
citiesCovered.description: We are connecting cities across Morocco, one by one. ColiFlow is expanding rapidly throughout the Kingdom. We currently offer person-to-person shipping services in the following major cities.
citiesCovered.footer: Other cities will be available soon. Contact us to select your city.

privacyPolicy.warningTitle: We take the protection of your personal data seriously
privacyPolicy.warningText: We never sell your data or share it with third parties without your consent.

items.title: Data Protection
items.desc: Your personal information and CIN documents are encrypted using the AES-256 algorithm and are never shared with third parties.

items.title: Location
items.desc: We use your location only to help you find travelers or shippers nearby. Location data is never stored permanently.

items.title: Cookies
items.desc: We use cookies solely to keep you logged in and to enhance your user experience. We do not use any third-party tracking cookies.
